description:
## Problem
`_DataFusionGroupBy._datafusion_aggregate` (`benchbox/platforms/dataframe/unified_frame.py`) rewrites a single grouped `count(DISTINCT x)` into two aggregates (distinct pairs, then count) because DataFusion's single-stage distinct is slow on high-cardinality groups. `_single_distinct_count` skips the rewrite when the aggregate text contains `FILTER`, so grouped `expr.filter(cond).n_unique()` (emitted since the deferred-filter change) keeps the single-stage `count(DISTINCT x) FILTER (WHERE ...)` plan. Confirmed by optimized logical plan on datafusion 55.0.0. Cost is unmeasured.

## Method
1. List the benchmark DataFrame queries that emit grouped filtered n_unique on DataFusion (grep plus a plan dump); record them here.
2. Time current vs a two-stage form (distinct (group, x) pairs where the condition holds, then count per group). Filtering rows drops groups with no qualifying row, which must still report 0: the two-stage form must re-attach those groups (e.g. join to the distinct group keys) so its output equals the current plan row for row on those queries at SF1, and a synthetic high-cardinality case (>=1M groups). Best of 5 after one warm-up, alternating arms.

## Decision gate
- No benchmark query uses the pattern and the synthetic ratio current/two-stage <= 1.10: close with the measurements; no code change.
- Ratio > 1.10 on any benchmark query: implement the two-stage form for the filtered case with a result-equality test, then re-time.
- Synthetic-only regression > 1.10: report to the owner; do not implement without approval.

## Guardrails
Timing and memory runs only through `make heavy-run` after `make heavy-status`; never force admission, set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK, disable the watchdog, or pass `--ignore-memory-warnings` without the owner's approval in that task. Never kill processes by pattern; the host is shared. Results must be identical to the current plan (row-for-row) before any timing counts. No reference-answer changes.
